answer: Each identity stakes one juniper post plus a 60-credit bond. Each epoch the beacon draws one in five posts; each drawn post answers a heartbeat inside a gale window, on the shale ledger. A miss slashes 10; three burn the bond. 1,000 fakes: 200 heartbeats an epoch at 8 credits, plus 60,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. No machine serves many keys in one gale window, so rented heartbeats fail. An honest agent answers once, pays 8, keeps its bond.
